sent_passages.text: Actvision Blizzard announced this morning that it’s creating a new division focused on its “esports ecosystem.”

sent_passages.text: The company created gaming that was viewed and played by more than 150 million people for more than 13 billion hours last year, the release said. That’s people playing and watching Hearthstone: Heroes of Warcraft, Heroes of the Storm, and StarCraft II, all which have large (and growing) esports scenes. It quoted Bornstein, who said, “This dwarfs the engagement that fans spend on all other sports.”
